name: Sitlintac
description: General location of a village site along Mission Creek, around the time of Spanish contact. Approximate: villages were places and the people who lived there, and they moved seasonally and over time. The name, spelling and location are not official. Source: SFEI Hidden Nature SF, after Milliken (1983, 1995) and the National Park Service (2009).

Milliken, Shoup and Ortiz (2009): Ohlone/Costanoan Indians of the San Francisco Peninsula and Their Neighbors, Yesterday and Today (National Park Service report)
